summary: A member has a short list of colleagues to bring to the chamber when the clerk calls the roll.
realLife: Humphrey and Kuchel divided responsibility for getting supporters to quorum calls.
gates: Supporters must be present to establish a quorum.
inGame: needs: responsibility for attendance calls and a record of who answered each call.

turns.what: The floor manager keeps one central list for the evening.
turns.pulledBy: Too few members remain in the building to cover separate lists.
turns.writesBack: The manager's desk handles every attendance check.

turns.what: A member hands the last two names back to the desk.
turns.pulledBy: Those colleagues have already left for committee business.
turns.writesBack: The desk takes responsibility for locating them.
